commitResults.messageBody:
Pasted nonbreaking spaces currently cancel delete and clear even though
the guide says surrounding spaces are ignored. Normalize the boundary
separators while retaining exact lowercase confirmation and captured
targets. Cover all three actions, near misses and interior separators.

Fixes #339

commitResults.messageTitle: Correct cumulative filter checks in the guide
commitResults.messageBody:
Reset the view between independent search examples and separately test
cumulative conditions and tag-group identity. Explain the same rules in
the regenerated lifecycle diagram so correct behavior is not reported as
a failed manual check.

Fixes #340

commitResults.messageTitle: Align backup retry and tag helper documentation
commitResults.messageBody:
UC07 contradicts storage safeguards by saying matching-data retries do
not rotate the backup. Explain that a successful explicit retry preserves
the warned-about outside file even when member values match the session.

Point bulk-tag feedback to TagUpdateUtil after the shared helper moved.
These are documentation corrections; production behavior is unchanged.

Fixes #343
Fixes #344

An inaccessible parent makes Files.exists return false even when the
roster is present. Treat only confirmed absence as a first run, so
access failures reach the existing recovery handling instead of
opening an editable sample roster.

Add a permission-based regression that preserves the original bytes,
restores directory permissions, and verifies the roster loads again.

commitResults.messageTitle: Select a sole member with arrow keys
commitResults.messageBody:
JavaFX leaves a focused single row unselected because both arrow
handlers stop at the list boundary. Handle unmodified arrows for that
one-row case so the documented F2 navigation reveals member details.

Keep F2 focus-only and preserve multi-row navigation, modifier keys,
and Escape privacy behavior. Cover the boundary and these controls
through the real MainWindow and ListView event handlers.

Check that a non-arrow navigation key still reaches JavaFX and reveals
the selected member. This covers the event-filter fallback branch
without changing functional code or the freeze budget.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify filter tests and lifecycle transitions
commitResults.messageBody:
Define repeated filters by complete tag-set identity and separate the
cumulative-search check from independent searches. Include the exact
repeat feedback so manual testers can verify the existing behavior.

Show that applied adds reset filters even when saving fails, and make
the final-chip transition unambiguous in the regenerated diagram.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align add-reset wording across the guide
commitResults.messageBody:
Use applied add consistently in the ordering table and show-selection
rules. An add resets the view before persistence, so a failed save
must not imply that the old conditions remain active.

A failed active-roster write restores a temporary copy of the old backup.
Copy its attributes too so rollback does not remove shared write access.

Cover five POSIX modes, unchanged file contents and successful-save
controls. Skip the permission-specific check on non-POSIX filesystems.

The command field strips pasted tabs before parsing, contrary to the
published separator promise. Explain the effect on contact values and
confirmation replies, and use ordinary spaces in manual test guidance.

Keep the underlying input-handling defect tracked in issue #351. This
changes documentation only while the functional fix remains unresolved.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support common punctuation in member names
commitResults.messageBody:
Allow periods and slashes in the shared name validator so ordinary
spellings survive commands, CSV transfers and saved-roster reloads.
Keep standalone s/o and d/o abbreviations literal during prefix checks,
while continuing to reject malformed member-field prefixes.

Cover add, edit, round trips, duplicate matching and atomic invalid
imports, and update the field guidance to match the accepted grammar.
Normalize spaces around pending confirmations

Add the optional portfolio with verified feature, review and release
evidence so readers can trace Ian's work. Link it from About Us and
identify his documented Codex use in the Developer Guide.

Keep the final v1.6 release checklist separate from this documentation
change. No application behaviour changes.
